intro: Use Session 4 to move from correlation to mechanisms: education and health production, early-life shocks, income, stress and rank, inequality, reverse causality and time preference.
attribution: Independent student-written study guide based on Daniele Fabbri’s Fundamentals in Health Economics, Session 4: Socio-economic Disparities in Health, University of Bologna. Official slides and textbook answer keys are not reproduced. Always check Virtuale for the official materials.
